title: Neighborhood park map / 社区公园地图
goal:
Create a bilingual walking map for new neighbors.
给新邻居做一份中英双语步行地图 🌿
context:
A volunteer group is preparing a free weekend walk. The first discussion chose an offline map.
志愿者准备周末免费步行活动，首轮讨论决定使用离线地图。

decisions.text: Use a printable A4 map / 使用可打印的 A4 地图
decisions.source: Synthetic planning note, message 2 / 合成讨论第 2 条

decisions.text: Consider a QR code for accessible routes / 考虑用二维码补充无障碍路线
decisions.source: Synthetic planning note, message 3 / 合成讨论第 3 条

rejected.text: Do not collect visitor location data / 不收集游客位置数据
rejected.source: Synthetic planning note, message 4 / 合成讨论第 4 条

next_steps.text:
Verify bus stops and accessible entrances.
核对公交站和无障碍入口 📝
next_steps.source: Synthetic planning note, message 5 / 合成讨论第 5 条
